title: Herstellung und Charakterisierung von Nb- und Ta-Al₂O₃-Verbundwerkstoffen für Hochtemperaturanwendungen
bookshelves: Category: Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, Industrial processes
summary: Newly designed coarse-grained Nb-/Ta-Al₂O₃ refractory composite materials with multi-scale structure are potential candidates for high-temperature applications. As a basis, this work deals with the synthesis of composites using Field Assisted Sintering (FAST) to get a better understanding of both the influence of material composition and the particle size distribution of the starting powders on structural, electrical and mechanical properties.
